title: api: schema versioning - deprecations, beta headers, backward-compat shims
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: standardize request/response schema versioning across our public API surfaces (streaming, function/tool-calling, structured outputs) and the OpenAI compatibility shim. This PR introduces a first-class versioning header, conservative deprecation semantics, and lightweight backward-compatibility shims so existing clients do not break when we roll forward.

What this change does (summary):
- Introduces X-Redwood-API-Version and X-Redwood-Beta headers to allow clients to opt into schema versions and beta behaviors.
- Adds a canonical `schema_version` field for response payloads and documents the new v2 schema for function/tool-calling and structured output.
- Deprecates the legacy `response_format` top-level field (previously used to toggle structured output modes); server now honors it but returns a deprecation warning header and telemetry event.
- Implements a compatibility layer in the OpenAI-compat adapter that translates older OpenAI-style requests into the new schema (shims live under openai_compat/). Shims perform minimal field mapping and emit warnings.
- Adds automated detection + warning for streaming payloads that mix old/new fields, and a streaming shim that rewrites chunk envelopes to the v2 format.
- Adds migration docs and SDK helpers to set API version headers and to parse deprecation warnings.

Compatibility and migration notes:
- Default behavior: requests without X-Redwood-API-Version continue to be served using the current stable schema but will include a X-Redwood-API-Deprecation-Warn header for deprecated fields. This gives a 6-week runway before we flip default behavior for any given field.
- Beta opt-in: clients can set X-Redwood-Beta: schema=v2 to opt into the new behaviors early. Beta headers are additive and scoped (e.g. schema=v2, streaming=v2).
- Shims are intentionally conservative and limited in scope: they do not attempt to reinterpret user intent (no prompt rewriting), only structural translations (field renames, envelope wrapping).

Testing and rollout plan:
- Unit and integration tests added for streaming translation, function-calling mapping, and OpenAI-compat shim.
- Canary rollout to 10% of traffic behind the feature flag `api_schema_versioning.v2_canary`.
- Observability: new metrics `api.schema_version.requests`, `api.schema_deprecation.warnings`, and tracing tags to correlate shims.

Checklist:
- [x] API header parsing and validation
- [x] Response header warning and telemetry event emission
- [x] OpenAI-compat shims for function-tool calling and streaming envelopes
- [x] SDK parsing helpers (python + ts)
- [x] Documentation + migration guide

Related: ENG-7310, SUP-1428. This PR is intentionally conservative; follow-ups will include an automated migration tool and an admin UI to manage deprecation timelines.
